items.text: Can explain what a VPC is and why it is needed using an analogy
Understand the difference between a public and private subnet
Can explain what a Route Table does and what the local route means
Understand how an Internet Gateway works and the difference vs NAT Gateway
Can explain NACL stateless behavior and why ephemeral ports matter
Can explain Security Group stateful behavior and why return traffic is auto-allowed
Created a custom VPC with a defined CIDR block in the AWS Console
Created a subnet and associated it with an Availability Zone
Created and attached an Internet Gateway to a VPC
Updated a Route Table to add an internet route (0.0.0.0/0 → IGW)
Created a NACL with inbound and outbound rules including ephemeral port allowance
Created a Security Group with SSH inbound rule
Launched an EC2 instance inside a custom VPC and connected via SSH
Can answer: What is the difference between NACL and Security Group?
Can answer: Which load balancer supports path-based routing? (Application Load Balancer)
Can answer: Which load balancer supports Elastic IP? (Network Load Balancer)
Can answer: How many IPs does AWS reserve per subnet? (5)
Can answer: How many Internet Gateways can a VPC have? (1)
Can answer: What makes a subnet public? (Route to Internet Gateway)
